objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of Python
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world Python tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in Python
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with Python industry best practices

prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and ability to run commands in a terminal

modules.title: Module 1: Python Runtime Architecture, Memory Model & Primitives
modules.summary: Explore CPython virtual machine internals, stack evaluation, heap allocation, name binding, and IEEE 754 numeric types.
lessonTitles: Python Execution Architecture, Bytecode & Object Model
Primitive Types, IEEE 754 Arithmetic & Formatted IO
modules.checkpoint: Analyze object memory addresses, reference counting, and type conversion boundaries.

modules.title: Module 2: Control Flow, Iteration Protocols & Defensive Error Handling
modules.summary: Understand short-circuit boolean logic, structural pattern matching, memory-efficient generators, and custom iteration protocols.
lessonTitles: Decision Logic, Short-Circuit Evaluation & Pattern Matching
The Iteration Protocol, Generators & Streaming Pipelines
modules.checkpoint: Build generator pipelines with O(1) space complexity and implement pattern matching routers.

modules.title: Module 3: Metaprogramming, OOP Architecture & Automated Verification
modules.summary: Master closures, decorators with functools.wraps, dunder protocol design, and production-grade pytest test suites.
lessonTitles: OOP Architecture, Dunder Protocols & Automated Pytest Suites
modules.checkpoint: Design encapsulated domain models with dunder methods and verify behavior using automated pytest suites.

practiceActivities: Trace and diagram CPython reference counts, memory addresses, and object bindings using id() and sys.getrefcount()
Implement an unbuffered, memory-efficient streaming generator pipeline for gigabyte-scale access logs
Build a production-grade decorator suite for latency telemetry, caching, and rate limiting with functools.wraps
Develop a domain entity with dunder protocols (__eq__, __hash__, __repr__) and full pytest test coverage
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Python Runtime Architecture, Memory Model & Primitives Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Control Flow, Iteration Protocols & Defensive Error Handling Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Metaprogramming, OOP Architecture & Automated Verification Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Enterprise Telemetry & Resilient Order Processing Engine with Pytest Validation Suite
proficiencyCriteria: Explain CPython execution mechanics: compilation, bytecode disassembling, object heap allocation, and garbage collection
Prevent mutable default argument traps, unhandled conversion exceptions, and memory reference cycles
Design composable generator pipelines that maintain O(1) space complexity across large datasets
Write maintainable, strictly typed, PEP 8 compliant software validated by automated test suites
